0022600109.text: The Mavericks (1-1, eighth in the West, third in the Southwest and 0.5 games back) host the Spurs (0-1, 11th in the West, fifth in the Southwest and 1 game back). Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (shoulder soreness), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Dallas lost all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
